caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, slightly irregular medallion with a bas-relief design of an eagle at its center. The eagle is shown in profile facing left, with its head raised and beak open, and features a detailed depiction of feathers on its head, body, and wings. Its left wing is partially extended upward, while the right wing curves downward along the side of its body. The eagle's feet grip swirling, cloud-like formations at the bottom of the medallion. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance, with highlighted and shadowed areas emphasizing the sculpted relief look. Holes and marks are present near the edge of the medallion, and the outermost rim is uneven, suggesting wear or aging. The background within the oval is a flat, slightly lighter gray, and the signature “ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE” is faintly visible in the lower right corner outside the medallion.
title: Firemark
